name: Kristina Hayden
why: Her own studio class portrait, the best frame the archive holds of her; the alternative is a face in a fifteen-person group shot on p. 114.
caption_quote: KRISTINA HAYDEN, Frankfort

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 349, freshman class portraits (row 9, third of six). The row's six portraits match its six printed names in order, RON HARRIS to KEVIN HAZELWOOD, with the two men first and last as printed; the volume's index entry "Hayden, Kristina Elizabeth 114, 349" ties this portrait to the Associated Student Government group photograph on p. 114.

name: Kim Summers
why: Quarantined crop confirmed against the page and released. A studio class portrait, taken the year before her term as public relations vice-president; the only alternative is her face in a fifteen-person group shot on p. 114.
caption_quote: KIMBERLY SUMMERS, Louisville

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 345, sophomore class portraits (row 2, third of six). The row's six portraits match its six printed names in order, MARY STICH to DONNA TAYLOR. The volume's index carries a single Summers of that name, "Summers, Kimberly Bilete 114, 119, 345", which ties this portrait to the Associated Student Government group photograph on p. 114, where the third woman in the front row is captioned Kimberly Summers.

name: Adrian Smoot
why: Quarantined crop confirmed against the page and released. A crop from a thirteen-person group shot, and the only frame of him the archive holds: p. 25 of the same volume discusses his King holiday resolution but carries no photograph of him. Taken in 1986-87, two years before the term it is filed under.
caption_quote: FRONT ROW: Holger Velastegui, Laura Tracy, Kent Groemling, Adrian Smoot

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 114, right-hand Associated Student Government group photograph, fourth and last man in the front row. The photograph's four front-row, five second-row and four back-row figures match its 4-5-4 printed name list exactly, and three faces already published from this same frame (Kent Groemling front row 3, Daniel Rodriguez back row 1, John Schocke back row 2) confirm the rows read left to right.

name: Chuck Newton
why: Small and soft, and a corner of the man in front of him shows at the bottom right, but it is the only frame of him the archive holds. The index sends him to two other pages, p. 186 and p. 227; p. 227 quotes him on the cheerleading squad and p. 186 is a Greek Week spread, and neither carries a photograph identified as him.
caption_quote: SECOND ROW: Andrea Collin, William Schilling, Chris Leneave, Chuck Newton, Jerry Castleberry

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 114, right-hand Associated Student Government group photograph, fourth of five in the second row. The photograph's 4-5-4 rows match the printed 4-5-4 name list exactly, and three faces already published from this frame (Kent Groemling front row 3, Daniel Rodriguez back row 1, John Schocke back row 2) confirm the rows read left to right.

name: Greg Robertson
why: Small and soft, being a face lifted out of a thirteen-person group shot, but it is the only frame of him in the volume: the index sends "Robertson, William Greg" to pp. 114-115 and nowhere else, so there is no class portrait to prefer.
caption_quote: BACK ROW: Daniel Rodriguez, John Schocke, Tim Todd, Greg Robertson

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 114, right-hand Associated Student Government group photograph, fourth and last man in the back row. The photograph's 4-5-4 rows match the printed 4-5-4 name list exactly, and the two faces already published from this back row (Daniel Rodriguez first, John Schocke second) confirm it reads left to right.

name: Carol Sue Norcia
why: A soft crop from a fifteen-person group shot, and the only frame available: she has no entry in the volume's index, so there is no class portrait to prefer. She is the first name in the front row and stands clear of her neighbours, so the crop is clean.
caption_quote: FRONT ROW: Carol Sue Norcia, Hollie Hale, Kimberly Summers, Karen Lassiter, Barbara Rush

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 114, left-hand Associated Student Government group photograph, first in the front row. The photograph holds five faces in each of its three tiers, matching the printed 5-5-5 name list, and the reading is checked at two points: the third front-row face is the Black woman the caption calls Kimberly Summers, and the fourth second-row face matches Kristina Hayden, both confirmed against their own class portraits on pp. 345 and 349 of the same volume.

name: Michelle Conner
why: Small and soft, a face out of a fifteen-person group shot, but it is the right one. The volume also prints a freshman class portrait captioned MICHELLE CONNER, Gamaliel on p. 347, which is a different student: the index separates "Conner, Michelle Lynn 347" from "Connor, Michelle Elaine 114", and only the second is sent to the government page. That sharper portrait was therefore rejected and this crop used instead.
caption_quote: SECOND ROW: Janet Dryer, Terri Wakefield, Michelle Conner, Kristina Hayden, Lynn Groemling

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 114, left-hand Associated Student Government group photograph, third of five in the second row. The photograph holds five faces in each of its three tiers, matching the printed 5-5-5 name list, and the reading is checked at two points: the third front-row face is the Black woman the caption calls Kimberly Summers, and the fourth second-row face, immediately to this woman's left, matches Kristina Hayden, both confirmed against their own class portraits on pp. 345 and 349.

name: Brian Sewell
why: A clean studio portrait, taken as a freshman two years before he joined Congress; no photograph of him in the government pages of any volume the archive can reach without a paced request.
caption_quote: BRIAN SEWELL, Louisville

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 359, freshman class portraits (row 4, sixth and last of six). The row's six portraits match its six printed names in order, LAURA SCHMITS to BRIAN SEWELL, and the two men in the list, RODNEY SCHWARTZ fourth and BRIAN SEWELL sixth, are the fourth and sixth faces. The volume's index carries one student of the name, "Sewell, Brian Lewis 359"; that a freshman of 1986-87 is the Congress member of 1988-89 rests on the name being unique in the volume, not on a caption tying him to student government.

name: Eddie Smith
why: A clean studio portrait, taken as a freshman two years before he joined Congress and three before he was treasurer.
caption_quote: EDDIE SMITH, Elizabethtown

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 359, freshman class portraits (row 6, fourth of six). The row's six portraits match its six printed names in order, ANDREA SMITH to RHONDA SNYDER, and the pattern of the faces, one woman then three men then two women, matches the pattern of the names exactly. The volume's index carries one student of the name, "Smith, Eddie Dee 359", among some fifty Smiths; that this freshman is the Congress member of 1988-89 rests on the given name being unique in the volume, not on a caption tying him to student government.

name: Dana Baith
why: Very small and soft, cut from a seventeen-man fraternity group photograph printed a quarter page wide, with a neighbour's shoulder at the left edge. Taken with it because it is the only photograph of the name in either volume the archive can reach freely, and he has no class portrait in the 1987 index.
caption_quote: SECOND ROW: Steven Tays, Shane McPherson, Rick Thurby, Dana Baith, Bill Downs

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 182, right-hand Alpha Gamma Rho group photograph, fourth of five in the second row. The photograph holds five, five and seven faces in its three tiers, matching the printed 5-5-7 name list exactly. The volume's index carries one student of the surname, "Baith, Dana Len 182", so the fraternity member and the 1988-89 Rules and Elections chairman are matched on a rare name rather than on any caption tying him to student government.

name: Kelly Neill
why: The weakest find in this block and offered as better than nothing. The face is tiny, cut from a sixteen-woman sorority photograph printed a third of a page wide, and the link to the Congress member of 1988-89 is her name and nothing else. She is in neither the 1986 nor the 1987 class portrait grids and has no other appearance in either volume.
caption_quote: BACK ROW: Wendy Combs, Kelly Neill, Amy Gardner, Diane Himes
quality: very small, group crop, person-match on name alone

src.label: 1986 Talisman, p. 277, third Kappa Delta group photograph, second of four in the back row. The photograph holds six, six and four faces, matching the printed 6-6-4 name list exactly. The volume's index carries one student of the name, "Neill, Kelly D. 277", and nothing in either volume ties her to student government.

name: Rob Evans
why: Quarantined crop confirmed against the page and released. A formal headshot printed with his own candidate profile, taken in the year it is filed under; newsprint halftone, so it is grainy, but it is a proper portrait rather than a face pulled out of a group.
caption_quote: ROB EVANS. Class: Junior. Hometown: Owensboro. Major: Health care administration

src.label: College Heights Herald, Vol. 66 No. 51, 2 April 1991, p. 1, "Meet the Candidates" box. The headshot sits immediately left of his name, and the profile beside it lists his ASG record as on-campus representative, public relations committee chairman, organization aid and student athletic committees and treasurer, which matches the offices the archive records for him, so the face is tied to the officer and not merely to the name.

name: Van Hodge
why: Quarantined crop confirmed against the page and released. A formal suit-and-tie headshot, and the best of him available; the alternative is his face in the fifteen-person 1987-88 group photograph. Newsprint halftone, so grainy. The frame is a candidate portrait in a boxed profile rather than any picture of the trouble he was in that spring, so it carries no censure with it.
caption_quote: VAN HODGE. Class: Junior. Hometown: Louisville. Major: Corporate Communications

src.label: College Heights Herald, Vol. 66 No. 51, 2 April 1991, p. 1, "Meet the Candidates" box, taken during his second term as public relations vice president. The headshot sits immediately left of his name, and the profile beside it lists his ASG record as freshman class vice president, sophomore class president, public relations committee chairman and public relations vice president, which matches the offices the archive records for him.

name: Dan Knowles
why: Quarantined crop confirmed against the page and released. A formal headshot printed with his own candidate profile; newsprint halftone with scanner speckle across the face, but it is a proper portrait and the only one of him the archive holds.
caption_quote: DAN KNOWLES. Class: Junior. Hometown: Kevil. Major: Corporate Communications

src.label: College Heights Herald, Vol. 66 No. 51, 2 April 1991, p. 1, "Meet the Candidates" box. The headshot sits immediately left of his name, and the profile beside it opens his ASG record with freshman class president, which the same paper reported him winning on 13 October 1988 (Vol. 64 No. 16), the year he was lobby coordinator, so the face is tied to the officer and not merely to the name.

name: Eric McWilliams
why: A studio portrait with its own printed name block, pasted into the Spirit Masters scrapbook; straightened by fourteen degrees because it was glued in at an angle. Taken the year after the term it is filed under, and the best frame of him the archive holds.
caption_quote: Eric McWilliams, Earlington, KY, Sophomore, Finance

src.label: WKU Spirit Masters scrapbook for 1991-92, UA12/2/16, "Meet our group" pages, where each member's portrait carries a printed block giving name, hometown, class and major. Sophomore in 1991-92 fits the Herald calling him a junior when he ran for the student government presidency in March 1993 (Vol. 68), and fits his 1990-91 term as an at-large representative in his freshman year.

name: Mark Miller
why: A studio portrait with its own printed name block, pasted into the Spirit Masters scrapbook at an angle and straightened by twenty-six degrees. Taken the year after the term it is filed under.
caption_quote: Mark Miller, Elizabethtown, KY, Sophomore, Computer Science

src.label: WKU Spirit Masters scrapbook for 1991-92, UA12/2/16, "Meet our group" pages, where each member's portrait carries a printed block giving name, hometown, class and major. Sophomore in 1991-92 means freshman in 1990-91, which is when the Herald of 2 October 1990 (Vol. 66 No. 12) reported Mark Miller elected freshman class president, the year the archive records him on the Organizational Aid and Campus Improvement committees.

name: Deven Delano
why: A studio portrait with its own printed name block, glued into the scrapbook at an angle and straightened by twenty-one degrees. The only photograph of him the archive has found.
caption_quote: Devin Delano, Evansville, IN, Senior, Marketing

src.label: WKU Spirit Masters scrapbook for 1991-92, UA12/2/16, "Meet our group" pages, where each member's portrait carries a printed block giving name, hometown, class and major. A senior in 1991-92 was a junior in 1990-91, which is the year and the class the archive records for him as a junior class officer. The scrapbook spells the given name Devin; the archive's roster reads Deven, and that difference is flagged rather than resolved.

name: Stacy Kitchens
why: A studio portrait with its own printed name block, glued into the scrapbook at an angle and straightened by thirteen degrees. Taken the year after the term it is filed under.
caption_quote: Staci Kitchens, Franklin, KY, Junior, Math/Economics

src.label: WKU Spirit Masters scrapbook for 1991-92, UA12/2/16, "Meet our group" pages, where each member's portrait carries a printed block giving name, hometown, class and major. A junior in 1991-92 was a sophomore in 1990-91, the year the archive records her in Congress. The scrapbook spells the given name Staci and the archive's roster reads Stacy; that difference is flagged rather than resolved, and the match rests on an uncommon surname and the class year rather than on any caption tying her to student government.

name: Deanna Mills
why: A studio portrait with its own printed name block, glued into the scrapbook at an angle and straightened by eighteen degrees.
caption_quote: Deanna Mills, Glasgow, KY, Sophomore, Public Relations

src.label: WKU Spirit Masters scrapbook for 1991-92, UA12/2/16, "Meet our group" pages, where each member's portrait carries a printed block giving name, hometown, class and major. Sophomore in 1991-92 puts her in the class of 1994, which is how the Herald described her in September 1994 (Vol. 70), and matches the archive's record of her on the Judicial Council in 1993-94, her senior year. She also wrote a letter to the Herald of 2 April 1991 backing Dan Knowles for the presidency.

name: Gretchen Ploch
why: A studio portrait with its own printed name block, glued into the scrapbook almost sideways and straightened by fifty-five degrees. The only photograph of her the archive has found.
caption_quote: Gretchen Ploch, Louisville, KY, Sophomore, Undeclared

src.label: WKU Spirit Masters scrapbook for 1991-92, UA12/2/16, "Meet our group" pages, where each member's portrait carries a printed block giving name, hometown, class and major. A sophomore in 1991-92 was a freshman in 1990-91, the year the archive records her as an at-large representative. The surname is rare and she appears in the same group as several of that year's Congress members, but nothing in the scrapbook ties her to student government by name.

name: Juli Carter
why: A studio portrait with its own printed name block, glued into the scrapbook at an angle and straightened by thirty degrees. The only photograph of her the archive has found.
caption_quote: Juli Carter, Tampa, FLA, Junior, Journalism

src.label: WKU Spirit Masters scrapbook for 1991-92, UA12/2/16, "Meet our group" pages, where each member's portrait carries a printed block giving name, hometown, class and major. A junior in 1991-92 was a sophomore in 1990-91, the year the archive records her as an at-large representative. The spelling Juli, unusual and matching the archive's roster exactly, is what ties the two records together; nothing in the scrapbook names her office.

name: Mistianna Holcomb
why: A formal headshot printed with her own candidate profile. The newsprint reproduction is very dark, so the levels have been stretched to make the face legible; nothing else is altered. It is the only photograph of her the archive holds.
caption_quote: Mistianna Holcomb. Class: Junior. Hometown: Murray. Major: History

src.label: College Heights Herald, Vol. 67 No. 51, 9 April 1992, p. 1, "Holcomb, Rains vying for presidency". The headshot sits under her name at the head of her own profile, and the ASG Experience line beside it reads member-at-large, sophomore representative, public relations vice president, which matches the offices the archive records for her in 1990-91 and 1991-92.
